description: Phase-distortion waveshaper: instead of clipping or folding the signal it modulates the signal's own phase, which adds overtones while leaving the level largely where it was

params.text: Sets how far the phase is pushed, 0 to 1; at 0 the signal passes through untouched
Shifts the phase by a fixed amount before the modulation, -180 to 180 degrees
Attenuates and inverts the AMT jack, -1 to 1, before that voltage is added to the AMT knob
Attenuates and inverts the BIAS jack, -1 to 1, before that voltage is added to the BIAS knob

inputs.text: The audio to be shaped; its channel count sets the polyphony of the whole module
The signal that does the modulating; with no cable it takes the signal input, which is what makes the module shape a signal with itself
Divided by 10, scaled by its attenuverter and added to the AMT knob, the total clamped to 0 and 1
Scaled by its attenuverter and added to the BIAS knob, the total clamped to the knob's own range

outputs.text: The shaped audio, with the DC taken out of it

notes: with no cable in the signal input the output is a single channel at 0V; nothing else on the panel matters until something is patched there
on a harmonically rich input it helps to filter the signal before sending it to the modulator jack, or the distortion turns to noise
menu: Oversampling: Off, 2x, 4x, 8x, 16x — runs the shaping above the sample rate to keep the new overtones from aliasing; it starts at 4x and adds a few dozen samples of delay

inputs.1:
±10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads Signal.
inputs.2:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 1V.
inputs.3:
±5V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±5V.
